lines.text: What are you coming in with today?
I'm coming in with heel pain that started two weeks ago.
Well, I tell a lie, it was three weeks ago, just after the fun run.
Correction, it was the Sunday before the fun run.
Did it start gradually or all at once?
All at once, on the first step out of bed.
It's pretty tight through the calf and plantar fascia, so I'll do some massage there.
I'll send you some exercises for the calf as well.
